concerns.text: T015a (grouping rare space groups) is marked [X] (complete) in the text but the 'Analyze Report' indicates it is 'REJECTED' and missing the input file. More critically, T015d (SC-002 hard gate) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires a hard pass/fail gate (SC-002) before training (T016). The task list fails to enforce this dependency; T016 is listed as dependent only on T015b (split), not T015d (validation gate). This allows training to proceed even if scaffold overlap is detected, violating SC-002.

SC-001 requires 'Model accuracy > Majority Baseline + [deferred] lift'. T017b (Majority Baseline) is marked [ ] (incomplete) and T017c (Success Criterion Verification) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The task list does not provide a mechanism to calculate the baseline or verify the lift before final metrics are generated. This creates a semantic gap where the success criterion cannot be verified, violating the spec's testability requirement.

The Plan explicitly mandates 'Top-K Accuracy (K=5) and Prediction Entropy' as primary metrics to handle polymorphism. T019d (generating polymorphism_metrics.json) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without this task, the project cannot scientifically address the 2D-to-3D ambiguity defined in the Plan and Constitution Principle VI, effectively weakening the research methodology.

SC-004 requires a 6-hour hard limit. T030 (timing log) and T030a (explicit build failure) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The task list lacks a mechanism to enforce the time limit as a hard gate. If T030a is not implemented, the pipeline may run indefinitely or complete silently after the limit, violating the performance constraint.

SC-003 requires a feature importance report with >= 20 annotated bits. T022 (Permutation Importance), T023 (SHAP), and T025 (Report Generation) are marked [ ] or [~] (incomplete/unclear). The task list fails to ensure the generation of the required report artifact, leaving the interpretability requirement unfulfilled.

The Plan mandates that timeout handling must 'reduce tree count' and NOT 'sample data'. T018a (timeout_handler) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without this specific implementation, the system risks violating the Plan's constraint by potentially sampling data or failing silently, which is a semantic weakening of the resource management strategy.

T006b (Power Analysis) appears in Phase 2 (Foundational) and Phase 4 (User Story 2). The Plan states Power Analysis must be 'executed after data ingestion'. Placing it in Phase 2 (before T013 ingestion) creates a logical contradiction where the task cannot be executed as specified. This is a semantic drift in the task ordering that violates the Plan's sequencing constraint.
